name: Aminata Strand-Otieno
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics
description:
Aminata Strand-Otieno is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 33, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) — and he makes no effort to hide it.

His entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. He works as a counterintelligence specialist out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Aminata Strand-Otieno is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who he burned last.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
psychology.secret: Aminata Strand-Otieno maintains a second identity — a completely clean civilian persona with a lease, a job history, and a social profile. It's their exit strategy.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: Aminata Strand-Otieno discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Aminata Strand-Otieno's reputation — and a price for silence
The fixer who handles Aminata Strand-Otieno's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: As a counterintelligence specialist, Aminata Strand-Otieno embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
A child being put in danger as leverage against them
